blurb: Serpent River Campground offers large, convenient pull through sites nestled between Hwy 17 (the Trans Canada Highway) and the beautiful Serpent River. If you are camping, or prefer to stay in a cabin, we’ve got you covered. Our guests enjoy our many facilities such as clean washrooms, showers, inground pool and general store.
